description_en: Queries the details of a video stream push job, such as the creation time, current push status, job type, and push URL
description_zh: 调用接口QueryStreamPushJob查询视频推流任务详情：创建时间、当前推流状态、任务类型、推流地址等
name: QueryStreamPushJob

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation to query the information of all products under the current account.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The DeviceName of the device.
You can view the DeviceName on the Devices page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The device ID. This is the ID that IoT Platform issues to the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html operation of IoT Platform to query the device ID.

<notice> As the unique identifier of the device, IotId has a one-to-one mapping with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview tab in the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页签，查看当前实例的ID
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en:
The response code.

200: The call is successful.
Other values: An error code. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

Data.description_en: The result returned if the call is successful

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the job was created. Unit: seconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间，单位为秒

JobType.description_en:
The type of the stream push job. Valid values:

1: Continuous job.
2: Triggered job, which ends after an interruption
JobType.description_zh:
推流任务类型。

1：持续型任务。
2：触发式任务，中断后结束

PushStatus.description_en:
The current stream push status. Valid values:

1: Pushing.
2: Waiting to push.
3: Push ended
PushStatus.description_zh:
当前推流状态。

1：正在推流。
2：等待推流。
3：推流结束

StreamType.description_en:
The stream type. Valid values:

0: Main stream.
1: Sub stream
StreamType.description_zh:
码流类型。

0：主码流 。
1：辅码流

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
